set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=4e2bf05aca4b60115da6c1584920f6ee278e3534
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
test -f frontend/src/components/content/contentBlocks.ts
git mv frontend/src/components/content/contentBlocks.ts frontend/src/components/content/contentBlockUtils.ts
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('frontend/src')
changed = []
for path in root.rglob('*'):
    if path.suffix not in {'.ts', '.tsx'}:
        continue
    text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    updated = text.replace('content/contentBlocks', 'content/contentBlockUtils').replace('./contentBlocks', './contentBlockUtils')
    if updated != text:
        path.write_text(updated, encoding='utf-8')
        changed.append(path.as_posix())
stale = []
for path in root.rglob('*'):
    if path.suffix not in {'.ts', '.tsx'}:
        continue
    text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    if 'content/contentBlocks' in text or './contentBlocks' in text:
        stale.append(path.as_posix())
print('updated_import_files=' + str(len(changed)))
for item in changed:
    print(item)
if stale:
    print('stale_imports=' + ','.join(stale))
    raise SystemExit(31)
PY
git diff --check
cd frontend
npm ci
npm run typecheck
VITE_API_BASE_URL= npm run build
cd ..
git status --short
git add frontend/src
git commit -m 'Fix content block module casing for macOS'
git push origin HEAD:work/fix-content-block-case-collision
echo "pushed_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
